localizedDescriptions.en: Review email delivery and manage Resend email resources within the API key's permissions.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 在 API 密钥权限范围内查看投递情况并管理 Resend 邮件资源。

en: Review recent transactional email deliveries and summarize any failures by reason.
zh-CN: 检查最近的事务邮件投递情况，并按原因汇总失败项。

instructions.en: Create a Resend API key in your account and enter it in plugin settings. Sending requires a permitted sender.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Resend 账号中创建 API 密钥，再填入插件设置。发送邮件需要获准的发件人。
